[[Marc Thompson]] ([[JN102]]-present)| }} '''Gary's Arcanine''' (Japanese: '''シゲルのウインディ''' ''Shigeru's Windie'') was a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} obtained by {{Gary}} during his {{pkmn|journey}} in the [[Kanto]] [[region]]. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|OS}}==== [[File:Gary Arcanine OS.png|thumb|left|220px|Arcanine in {{aniseries|OS}}]] Arcanine debuted in ''[[EP063|The Battle Of The Badge]]''. Gary sent it out to battle {{an|Giovanni}}'s {{p|Kingler}} at the [[Viridian City]] [[Viridian Gym|Gym]]. Despite having a type disadvantage, Arcanine came out on top and defeated the {{type|Water}} opponent. However, both his Arcanine and {{p|Nidoking}} were then easily defeated by {{OBP|Mewtwo|M01}}, leaving Gary confused as to both why he lost and what kind of Pokémon he had just battled. This battle was seen again briefly from Mewtwo's perspective in ''[[M01|Mewtwo Strikes Back]]'' and its remake ''[[M22|Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution]]''. [[File:EP228.png|thumb|220px|Arcanine in the Extreme Pokémon Race]] ===={{aniseries|GS}}==== In ''[[EP228|Extreme Pokémon!]]'', Gary used Arcanine to compete in the [[Extreme Pokémon Race]]. {{Ash}} initially thought Gary was mistreating the Pokémon, but after learning that it wasn't hurt, he competed as well. Ash decided to compete with his {{AP|Bayleef}}, which proved to be a good choice. During the competition, {{TRT}} tried to catch Arcanine. They failed, however, thanks to Ash's intervention and after defeating the trio with the help of Gary, both decided to continue the competition where Ash ultimately defeated Gary with great effort in his first victory over his great rival. In ''[[EP270|Can't Beat the Heat!]]'', Gary used Arcanine during the second half of his [[Silver Conference]] battle against Ash, where it was pitted against [[Ash's Snorlax]]. Although it dodged Snorlax's {{m|Body Slam}}, Arcanine's {{m|Take Down}} and {{m|Fire Spin}} had minimal effect on Snorlax, who then knocked it out with {{m|Hyper Beam}}. After he decided to become a Pokémon Researcher, Gary left Arcanine, along with most of his other Pokémon, with his grandfather. ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== In ''[[JN102|Battling in the Freezing Raid!]]'', Gary was revealed to have recalled Arcanine to his team. He used it as his third Pokémon during his {{OBP|Raid Battle|GO}} against an {{p|Articuno}}, but despite landing some powerful hits, it was eventually defeated by a {{m|Sheer Cold}}. ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Gary and Arcanine.png|thumb|250px|Arcanine and Gary]] [[File:Gary Arcanine M22.png|thumb|left|250px|Arcanine in ''[[M22|Pokémon: Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution]]'']] Arcanine is one of the strongest Pokémon on Gary's team. In its first appearance, it was strong enough to beat an opponent with a type advantage in only three blows. Arcanine was fast enough to put Gary in a comfortable position in the Extreme Pokémon Race even with the many unforeseen events that occurred during the race's duration. Gary appears to have enough confidence in Arcanine that he even kissed his Poké Ball before sending it into battle. In addition, in the Japanese version of its debut episode, Gary refers to Arcanine as being "My honey" (ぼくのハニー), strongly suggesting that it was one of his favorite Pokémon. Arcanine is shown to help its teammates in battle, as seen in ''[[JN102|Battling in the Freezing Raid!]]'', where it took a {{m|Sheer Cold}} attack meant for [[Horace]]'s {{p|Bayleef}} and saved it from getting knocked out so it would still be helpful in battle. {{-}} ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|fire||Gary Arcanine {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Fire Spin|1=Fire Blast|2=Take Down|3=Flame Wheel|4=Flamethrower}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Fire Spin|1=Fire Blast|2=Take Down|3=Flame Wheel|4=Flamethrower}}}} {{anmov|normal|Take Down|EP063|The Battle of the Badge}} {{anmov|fire|Fire Spin|EP063|The Battle of the Badge{{tt|*|Arcanine could not legally learn Fire Spin at the time}}}} {{anmov|fire|Fire Blast|EP063|The Battle of the Badge}} {{anmov|fire|Flame Wheel|EP228|Extreme Pokémon!}} {{anmov|fire|Flamethrower|JN102|Battling in the Freezing Raid!|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|fire}} ==In the manga== [[File:Silver Conference Scoreboard AP.png|thumb|180px|Arcanine in Ash & Pikachu]] ===Ash & Pikachu=== Arcanine only appeared on the scoreboard in ''[[SP16|One Half Of A Poké Ball]]''. Arcanine was one of the Pokémon used in [[Full Battle]] against Ash. [[File:Gary Arcanine EToP.png|thumb|left|200px|Arcanine in The Electric Tale of Pikachu]] [[File:Gary M22 manga.png|thumb|200px|Arcanine in ''Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution'']] ===The Electric Tale of Pikachu=== Arcanine appeared in ''[[ET19|Ash vs. Gary]]'', where Gary used it to try to capture a {{pkmn2|giant}} {{p|Slowpoke}}. He also used Arcanine to track down {{TRT}} when they stole the Slowpoke. Later, Arcanine battled against Slowpoke, but with little success, eventually being {{status|frozen}} by its {{m|Ice Beam}}. Arcanine also appeared in ''[[ET20|Epilogue: Wild Type]]'', alongside to {{OBP|Ash's Pikachu|EToP}}. ===Movie adaptations=== Arcanine appeared in ''{{ma|Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution}}''. Gary used it in his Gym battle against Giovanni alongside Nidoking, where it was overwhelmed by Mewtwo's Psychic powers. {{-}} ==In the spin-off games== [[File:Gary Arcanine Pokémon Puzzle League.png|thumb|200px|Arcanine in [[Pokémon Puzzle League]]]] ===[[Pokémon Puzzle League]]=== Arcanine is one of Gary's three Pokémon in {{g|Puzzle League}}, being used in the game's final challenge. Although Gary is playable as well, his playable appearance has him using a {{p|Growlithe}} instead of Arcanine. {{-}} ==Trivia== [[File:Gary Growlithe.png|thumb|220px|Growlithe and Gary]] * Apart from {{game|Yellow}}, Gary's [[core series]] [[cross-canon counterpart|counterpart]], {{ga|Blue}}, uses Arcanine in all his core series teams where he does not use a {{p|Charizard}}. * In the Japanese opening, [[The Rivals]], and its English equivalent, {{so|Pokémon World}}, Gary is shown with a {{p|Growlithe}}. Gary's counterpart in [[Pokémon Puzzle League]] also appears to use the same Pokémon, which evolves in the progress of the game, but it is unknown if it is the same case in the {{pkmn|animated series}}. * During its debut episode, Arcanine was seen using {{m|Fire Spin}}. However, Arcanine was [[Animated series move errors|unable to learn Fire Spin]] at the time, only becoming able to learn it from [[Generation II]] onward. * Before Gary’s first partner Pokémon was revealed, his Arcanine was commonly depicted as his signature Pokémon in other media such as [[Pokémon Puzzle League]] and [[Pokémon Master Trainer (1999)]]. {{-}} ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Arcanine}} {{Gary's Pokémon|fire}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Gary's Pokémon|Arcanine]] [[Category:Pokémon with animated series move errors]] [[Category:Ash & Pikachu characters]] [[Category:Electric Tale of Pikachu characters]] [[de:Garys Arkani]] [[es:Arcanine de Gary]] [[fr:Arcanin de Régis]] [[it:Arcanine di Gary]] [[ja:シゲルのウインディ]] [[zh:小茂的风速狗]]
